title: Anxiety, Alcohol, and Academics: A Textual Analysis of Student Facebook Confessions Pages (Research Note)
reasoning: The paper is a sociolinguistic analysis of student confessions on social media using LDA and LIWC. While it includes the 'religious affiliation' of institutions as a predictor variable and identifies religion in some confession content, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, ethics, or moral reasoning within an AI or NLP context.
